title: Check the compliance calendar each week
goal: Every obligation past its alert date is either met with its evidence or open as a decision for the founder, and every new grant or lease has the duties it creates recorded.

steps.do: List every upcoming obligation whose alert date (twice its preparation days before the due date) has passed, most urgent first, not curable before late fee before curable.
For each one due, prepare what the owner needs to file, sign or pay (the form, the figures and the fee) and bring it to the founder as a decision.
Mark each obligation met only with its evidence (a filing receipt or proof of mailing), and roll a recurring one forward to its next due date.
Check new ownership grants and new leases for duties they create (an 83(b) within 30 days of a grant, a lease's notice date) and add each as an obligation.

done_criteria.check: Is every obligation past its alert date either met with evidence or open as a decision for the founder?
